    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">论文复现【DualMap: Online Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping for Natural Language Navigation in Dynamic Changing Scenes】</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01950" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">DualMap: Online Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping for Natural Language Navigation in Dynamic Changing Scenes</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/Eku127/DualMap" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">GitHub项目链接</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="部署环境">部署环境</h1>
<ul>
<li>Ubuntu 22.04</li>
<li>ROS2 Humble</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="开发环境安装">开发环境安装</h1>
<h2 id="下载源代码">下载源代码</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone --branch main --single-branch --recurse-submodules git@github.com:Eku127/DualMap.git
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd DualMap
</code></pre>
<h2 id="创建-conda-环境">创建 conda 环境</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">conda create -n dualmap python=3.10 -y
</code></pre>
<h2 id="激活环境">激活环境</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">conda activate dualmap
</code></pre>
<h2 id="强制使用清华源">强制使用清华源</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install cmake faiss-cpu==1.9.0 torch torchvision torchaudio tyro open_clip_torch wandb h5py openai hydra-core distinctipy ultralytics==8.3.103 dill supervision==0.25.1 open3d imageio natsort kornia rerun-sdk==0.22.1 record3d==1.4.1 pyliblzfse pypng tabulate pympler plyfile "numpy&lt;2.0" -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
</code></pre>
<h2 id="拉取-clip-模型库">拉取 CLIP 模型库</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install git+https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ultralytics/CLIP.git
</code></pre>
<h1 id="run-with-iphone">Run with iPhone</h1>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/Eku127/DualMap/blob/main/resources/doc/app_runner_record_3d.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">app_runner_record_3d.md</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601170108955-1970138596.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="修改参数">修改参数</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601165827032-2080280266.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601165917029-1443293321.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601165803050-652849068.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="运行测试">运行测试</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">python -m applications.runner_record_3d
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601165713181-1293131109.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-06-01_16-32-22" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="结果保存">结果保存</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在手机上点击停止录制，会自动保存后停止程序</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601165709283-919191683.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-06-01_16-32-59" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="offline-map-query">Offline Map Query</h1>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/Eku127/DualMap/blob/main/resources/doc/app_offline_query.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">app_offline_query.md</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601141803279-932535647.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="下载数据集">下载数据集</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>download the data here: <a href="https://hkustgz-my.sharepoint.com/personal/jjiang127_connect_hkust-gz_edu_cn/_layouts/15/onedrive.aspx?id=%2Fpersonal%2Fjjiang127%5Fconnect%5Fhkust%2Dgz%5Fedu%5Fcn%2FDocuments%2FPaper%2FRAL25%2FDatasets%2FDualMap%5FQuery%5FExamples&amp;ga=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">OneDrive</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601135636762-717769674.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>

<h2 id="下载模型">下载模型</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">wget -c --no-check-certificate https://hf-mirror.com/apple/MobileCLIP-S2-OpenCLIP/resolve/main/open_clip_pytorch_model.bin
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601135934250-114666797.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202606/3071480-20260601135920558-1051672692.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="运行测试-1">运行测试</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">python -m applications.offline_local_map_query
</code></pre>
